content: Iesu Iyau Tafaror Goa arimon Intagogoros Insur
Iesu on tafaror goa ikirir ibib i’nan ato On an baigibubunuotis on sinat Iesu aurin ato tafaror goa a tafaror goa turinai goa ta ta sigoyon si’yen on sitiyoboai mes.
Iesu iyau, “Dura bag, atonio osi goa woiten tiwag. Yau awurem dura bag: men agim tani arimon nin an efanai sinikirir inen mes; agim engon tutufin arimon sinboen sinribiriren sinsur.”
Yawas Wawanis a Baikokosar

Iesu on Olive Oyau on tefanai nan imair, ato an baigibubunuotis on bubuniai sinat aurin. Osi sitetemai siyau, “Ekasonei, atonio osi bobo engon tutufin on arimon meyan sinmatar a abi bobo inmatar onai wei iniyoboei wansagob Om am wera ibo umatabir men enat a ra kanfoun enat.”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi matam woneit, men woniyamai iyafan tani inisigoem mes.
Sabu sigaraba Yau Wabiui sebikakafun on arimon sinnat ato sinau, ‘Yau on Keriso!’ Ato osi arimon sabu sigaraba sinisigoes.

Omi arimon sabu sinbigagam on fonas auwatin wontatam a tafanam nanenei sinbigagam on duras wat wontatam,; baise omi men woniyababan mes. Atonio osi bobo nanaba on arimon sinmatar, baise osi bobo on men sebiyamai wonnos ra kanfoun on inat igat on.
Tafanam on arimon tous wat sinigagam bonen; baiaiwab on arimon tous wat sinigagam bonen. Tafanam engonai on arimon gomar a uruyoi sinmatar.
Atonio osi bobo engon tutufin on arimon jever koun ebosuruf egigiai usibaban eboai toub aurin mes ba.
“On an werai omi on arimon sabu sinfatumem ato sinimakiem a sinirabobim. Sabu engon tutufin on arimon sinisisiweiim yabin omi on Yau wobitutumeu on fasinai.
On an werai sabu sigaraba arimon asi baitutum inafeu; osi arimon tous sinkaseiris bonen a tous sinisisiweiis bonen.
Namon baisigogo aubairuruotis sigaraba arimon sinrobotet ato sabu sigaraba sinisigoes.
Yawas komasis on arimon inarat bag ato sabu sigaraba tuturas mat sebinuabo bonen on arimon asi nuabo inikafakakai.
Baise iyai iyafan nana infaskikin inan au kanfoun ingat on arimon inyawas.
Ato atonio Baiaiwab an Wasagobin on arimon tafanam au engon sinbino onai sabu engon tutufin sintatam; namon tafanam au kanfoun min innat.”
Beruber Komasin

Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Omi arimon sawar, ‘Beruber Komasin’ ato aubairuruotin Daniel i’yau on wonitai. On sawar min arimon tafaror goa amonai intatawar.” (Orot iyafan atonio buk ebiyab on: an yabin mamaba on ininonotai tiwag!)
“Namon osi sabu iyabon Judea tafanamai semama on sinawures au oyau siniyai sinan.
Orot iyafan an goa uwayob tefanai on men an wera inisawarai insur goa amonai an sawar inabo mes.
Orot iyafan an masauai ebobo on men inmatabir men inan an goai nan an beber inboai mes.
On an rai jever yas sisag aumas a jever nanatus susus aumas, osi auris on arimon komasin bag!
God aurin wonbayoi on omi men yabat yawarad an ra o Sabat an ra on nan woniyai wonan mes!
Yabin on an wera yawas wawanis on arimon sinkomas kwakwan, men ato ainau bag simamatar ba, ato tafanam anai bag imamatar inat ari ra i’gat nan. Ato gibui on yawas wawanis on men sinmatar men.
Baise God on ra idibonai nono; On bobo on men nanaba itafour on, men iyafan tani arimon nana yawasin itama on. Yabin On an sabu rurubinis auris on mes, God arimon ra inidibonai.
“Namon iyai iyafan inawurem inau, ‘Eite, Keriso atonio’ o ‘On min ato!’—Omi men wonitutumai mes.
Yabin baisigogo Keriso a baisigogo aubairuruotis on arimon sinrobotet; osi arimon bobo buburis a bobo baiduduranis sinafour onai osi sinafourtobon fofonin on arimon God an sabu sinisigoes.
Omi wontatam! Yau atonio dura ainau awurem weie bobo sinmatar.
“O sabu sinawurem sinau, ‘Eite on igat inai efan koiteterinai nan!’—omi men wongat wonan mes; o sinau, ‘Eite, on nin iyob emama!’—omi men wonitutum mes.
Yabin Orot Natun innanat on arimon nanamar ba kasakasau engon wera matan emon inai wera sifun on engon inboai.
“Menan nan orot jever usin rabobin yen on, kiwiu kikim on arimon sinruayo.”
Orot Natun Innat

Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Ato osi yawas wawanis insasawar gibunai on, wera arimon inwouman, roke arimon men intagawai men, siribod on arimon kasakasau emon sinafeu, a safamai sawar faiwaris sen on arimon asi efan sinisararen.

Namon sawar tani on kasakasau tefanai inrobotet iniyoboes Orot Natun on enat; ato sabu engon tutufin tafanamai semama on arimon sinatou, ato osi Orot Natun safam an kasakasauai faiwar gagamin a an kudidirin gagaminai innanat sinitai on.
Dour gagamin arimon sinbabain, ato On an anea iniyafares singat tafanam au engonai an sabu rurubinis sinruayois ato tafanam taigai inai tafanam taig reban i’gat on faratai nan.”
Bubudau Wengar an Baiyoboen
Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Bubudau wengar on inibebeyim. On an rai fafamen ebiyamai enat rifuis a nunubas semamatar on, rorous sibosuruf seyaya on wonsagob kwanda an ra on inat ebiufin.
On eta kaitamomai omi atonio osi bobo engon tutufin woniten on arimon wonsagob wera on inat ebiufin, ebotitiwag inbosuruf mes.
Omi wonnosin, atonio osi bobo engon tutufin sinmatar weie sabu ari nin semama on sinarab.
Safam a tafanam on arimon sintumai baise Yau au dura on arimon men insiwan on.”
Men Iyafan Tani Ra o Wera Isagob
Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Baise men iyafan tani isagob meyan arimon ra o wera innat: anea safamai on men sisagob o Orot Natun on men isagob; ab Tamat ekesin mom on isagob.
Orot Natun innanat on arimon bobo ato Noah an werai imamatar, on nanaba inmatar.
On an rai, weie sareu gagamin itgat, sabu on bayu siyam sitotom, orot a jever on sitatabin, osi atonio bobo on nana sifofour i’nat on an ra Noah inai wa gagamin amonai irui;
baise osi nana men sisagob bobo aifan imamatar on, weie sareu gagamin igat sabu engon tutufin siyamtotom sirarabob. Orot Natun innanat min arimon on bobo nanaba inmatar.
On an wera arimon orot ruam bobo sinbobo; ato orot tani on arimon God inboai inan, ato orot tani on arimon inikirir.
Jever ruam arimon agimai nan rafi sinfofor; jever tani on arimon God inboai inan ato jever tani on arimon inikirir.
Omi wonkaifarem tiwag, yabin omi men wosagob ra aifanai ami Bada arimon innat.
Orot goa matuanin wera itsagob meyan orot bainauotin enat on, ato orot isagob on mes on nana matan iteit itamama ato orot bainauotin on men itikirir itar an goa itaseb on.
On mes omi mat ra fufur wonbotitiwagim, yabin Orot Natun on arimon asir wera tani nan innat on an ra on omi men wonbinonot on.”
Agirotin Baitutumin o Men Baitutumin
Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Agirotin iyafan on baitutumin a gigiboanotin? On agirotin on an bada baibad itai an werai bag nan agirotis fani asi bayu inbibites.
Agirotin an bobo inbobo ato an bada innanat au go ingagaturai on yasisir gagamin bag on aurin!
Yau awurem dura bag, bada arimon an agirotin baibad initai an sawar engon tutufin inkaifaren.
Baise on agirotin komasin mes on, arimon on toun aurin inau, yau au bada on men arimon gariwat inmatabir men innat on,
ato on inbosuruf agirotin tuturan inarou a on arimon sabu sareu wawanis tomatomanis on mat bayu sinam sintotom.
Namon ra tani on ato agirotin on men inbinonot an bada inmatabir men innat a on an werai on arimon men insagob on an bada on enat.
On an bada on arimon komasinai bag inimakiai ato sabu baisigogo’otis mat nan inyeinis. Namon on nan arimon inatou wan initafoforen.”
